messages:
Anya Patel: Hey team — I'm starting Monday (Jun 15). Quick questions: 1) Am I pro-rated for PTO/holiday accrual since it's mid-month? 2) I bought a standing desk for WFH — what's the reimbursement process and cap? 3) Anything else I should enroll in this week? Thanks! :wave:

hr-bot: Anya Patel completed new hire forms (W-4, I-9) — welcome! :tada:

Kristin (People Ops): Welcome Anya! Short answers: PTO is pro-rated for partial-month hires; you'll see the pro-rated balance in Workday in ~24-48 hrs. Company-observed holidays are not pro-rated — if you're onboard before the holiday date you get it. For desk reimbursements, file via Expenses portal with receipt and a photo of setup. Limit is up to $500 one-time for equipment without a prior pre-approval. For >$500 please ping us for pre-approval. Use the expense category 'WFH equipment'.

Ben (Payroll): Note on payroll side — reimbursement shows on next payroll after approval. To make sure it hits the same pay cycle, submit by Friday 11:59pm PT and include 'Reimb: Desk' in the description. If you need direct deposit changes, go to https://pay.redwood.com/direct-deposit or send payroll@redwood.com. :money_with_wings:

Maya (Benefits): Health/dental/vision elections: if you enroll during onboarding, medical/dental are effective the first of the next month. Vision has a 30-day waiting period for some vendors — mine kicked in on the 1st of next month + 30 days. If you want FSA/HSA, enroll now — HSA has salary pre-tax deductions starting the next payroll cycle after enrollment.

Anya Patel: Thanks, Kristin/Maya. Do I need a manager sign-off for the desk reimbursement or just submit and People Ops will route?

Kristin (People Ops): Just submit in the portal and select your manager for approval; People Ops will spot-check and approve per policy. If you want IT to ship a monitor instead, we can do that and it won't count against your $500 personal purchase cap — see 'IT-provided equipment' in the onboarding doc.

Alex (IT): If you want a monitor or keyboard shipped, reply here with your desk dimensions and preferred monitor (24/27) and we'll put in the order within 3-5 business days. :package:

Ben (Payroll): Quick how-to for the portal: Go to Expenses -> New Claim -> Category: 'WFH equipment' -> Attach receipt (PDF/JPEG) -> Description: 'Reimb: Desk' -> Submit. Reimbursements coded 'EXP-REIM' on the payroll ledger.

Anya Patel: Perfect, doing that today. One more tiny thing — I submitted the W-4 but put the wrong filing status. Who should I DM to fix that?

Ben (Payroll): DM me (Ben) or email payroll@redwood.com and we'll update before the payroll cutoff. If it's past cutoff, it applies next cycle. :+1:

Kristin (People Ops): Glad to have you, Anya! If anything else pops up, ping #people-ops or @Kristin. :wave:

Anya Patel: Thanks everyone! :smile:
